description: Blinks an external LED wired through a 220Ω resistor to GPIO 17 (BCM) on a Raspberry Pi. A small Python program runs on the Pi itself, using the board's own python3.
author: jengakit

ui.hint: e.g. blink GPIO 17 every 200ms, slow pulse
ui.description: Triggers an external LED via the Pi's GPIO. ACTUATOR-class kit — the dashboard's safety gate intercepts the flash until you confirm you've wired the LED through a current-limiting resistor.

sample_prompts: Slow morse-S pattern on the GPIO 17 LED
Two long pulses then a half-second pause
